notes: Query bank for `npm run dental -- query` (services/analyst/scripts/dental.ts, Phase 4c). An entry with "sql" is one read-only SELECT, answered exactly by code (no model); an entry with "question" goes through reconcile-explain (gateway + model, every figure checked) and runs only when asked for by id or with --with-ask. Add entries freely; ids are unique, lowercase, hyphenated. TABLES: exceptions(code, severity, direction, grp, payer, date, cents, amount, payment_ids, bank_rows, detail) | matches(bank_row, bank_date, grp, payer, curve_date, lag_days, cents, amount, n_payments, payment_ids) | unmatched_curve(grp, payer, date, cents, amount, n_payments, payment_ids) | unmatched_bank(bank_row, date, grp, payer, kind, originator, cents, amount) | group_totals(grp, curve_amount, matched_amount, unmatched_amount) | file_checks(file, adapter, rows, check_name, ok, detail) | sources when present: deposit, ledger, bank, patients, procedures, carecredit, cherry, hfd (columns as the adapters load them; amounts in cents; names are never loaded). direction = bank minus Curve: negative = money missing from the bank, positive = extra money in the bank, neutral = no bank difference. Phase 4c: a "question" entry also names "facts", the sections of the DuckDB fact sheet it is answered from (totals, groups, losses, extra, timing, posting, payers, card, branch, eft, all); the model rewords only those facts and must cite [T#]/[G#]/[F#] for every figure. topics / topic / pair (DESIGN/xrplh-29 section 8): the console groups questions by topic; an exact (sql) entry and a model (question) entry that answer the same intent name each other in 'pair', and the console shows them as one question with 'Answer as: Table | Explained'. The CLI (npm run dental) ignores these fields.

queries.title: Every leak type found: how many and how much
queries.sql: SELECT code, severity, direction, count(*) AS items, sum(amount) AS amount FROM exceptions GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY amount DESC

queries.title: Money missing from the bank vs extra unposted money vs timing items
queries.sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'exception' AND direction = 'negative'), 0) AS missing_from_bank, coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'positive'), 0) AS in_bank_not_posted, coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'watch'), 0) AS timing_watch, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'neutral') AS posting_errors, count(*) AS items FROM exceptions

queries.title: The 10 largest leaks, with dates and payment IDs
queries.sql: SELECT code, date, amount, payer, payment_ids, detail FROM exceptions ORDER BY amount DESC, date LIMIT 10

queries.title: Leaks per day (which days to investigate)
queries.sql: SELECT date, count(*) AS items, sum(amount) AS amount, string_agg(DISTINCT code, ', ' ORDER BY code) AS codes FROM exceptions GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

queries.title: Leaks per insurance payer
queries.sql: SELECT payer, count(*) AS items, sum(amount) AS amount, string_agg(DISTINCT code, ', ' ORDER BY code) AS codes FROM exceptions WHERE payer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payer ORDER BY amount DESC

queries.title: Posted in Curve vs matched in the bank, per deposit group
queries.sql: SELECT grp, curve_amount, matched_amount, unmatched_amount, round(100.0 * matched_amount / nullif(curve_amount, 0), 2) AS matched_pct FROM group_totals ORDER BY curve_amount DESC

queries.title: Curve deposit sums that reached no bank credit
queries.sql: SELECT grp, payer, date, amount, n_payments, payment_ids FROM unmatched_curve ORDER BY date, grp

queries.title: Bank credits of a deposit group that match no Curve sum
queries.sql: SELECT bank_row, date, grp, payer, kind, amount FROM unmatched_bank ORDER BY date

queries.title: How many days each deposit group takes to reach the bank
queries.sql: SELECT grp, lag_days, count(*) AS credits, sum(amount) AS amount FROM matches GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY grp, lag_days

queries.title: Each card settlement (GB PY GLOBAL DEP) and the Curve day it pays
queries.sql: SELECT bank_date, curve_date, lag_days, amount, n_payments FROM matches WHERE grp = 'card_processor' ORDER BY bank_date

queries.title: Insurance EFTs received per payer
queries.sql: SELECT payer, count(*) AS remittances, sum(amount) AS amount, min(bank_date) AS first, max(bank_date) AS last FROM matches WHERE grp = 'insurance_eft' GROUP BY payer ORDER BY amount DESC

queries.title: Direct Deposit payments posted in Curve, per payer and day
queries.sql: SELECT payer, date, count(DISTINCT payment_id) AS payments, sum(cents) / 100.0 AS amount FROM deposit WHERE method = 'Direct Deposit' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY date, payer

queries.title: Payments posted per payment method
queries.sql: SELECT method, count(DISTINCT payment_id) AS payments, sum(cents) / 100.0 AS amount FROM deposit GROUP BY method ORDER BY amount DESC

queries.title: Production, adjustments, collections and collection rate per provider (ledger)
queries.sql: SELECT provider, coalesce(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'invoice'), 0) / 100.0 AS production, coalesce(-sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'adjustment'), 0) / 100.0 AS adjustments, (coalesce(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'deposit'), 0) - coalesce(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'payment' AND coalesce(method, '') <> 'Account Credit'), 0)) / 100.0 AS collected, round(100.0 * (coalesce(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'deposit'), 0) - coalesce(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'payment' AND coalesce(method, '') <> 'Account Credit'), 0)) / nullif(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'invoice'), 0), 1) AS collected_pct FROM ledger GROUP BY provider ORDER BY production DESC

queries.title: Write-offs and adjustments by type
queries.sql: SELECT method AS adjustment_type, count(*) AS items, -sum(cents) / 100.0 AS amount FROM ledger WHERE entry = 'adjustment' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY amount DESC

queries.title: Largest open patient balances (invoices - payments - adjustments)
queries.sql: SELECT pt_pseudonym AS patient, sum(cents) / 100.0 AS balance FROM ledger WHERE entry IN ('invoice', 'payment', 'adjustment') GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(cents) > 0 ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 15

queries.title: Patient money received (Deposit) but not applied (Account Credit)
queries.sql: SELECT pt_pseudonym AS patient, coalesce(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'deposit'), 0) / 100.0 AS received, coalesce(-sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'payment' AND method = 'Account Credit'), 0) / 100.0 AS applied, (coalesce(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'deposit'), 0) + coalesce(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE entry = 'payment' AND method = 'Account Credit'), 0)) / 100.0 AS unapplied FROM ledger GROUP BY 1 HAVING unapplied <> 0 ORDER BY abs(unapplied) DESC

queries.title: Bank credits by kind and originator
queries.sql: SELECT kind, originator, count(*) AS credits, sum(cents) / 100.0 AS amount FROM bank WHERE cents > 0 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY amount DESC

queries.title: Bank debits by kind and originator (fees, chargebacks, payroll, ...)
queries.sql: SELECT kind, originator, des, count(*) AS debits, -sum(cents) / 100.0 AS amount FROM bank WHERE cents < 0 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Card processor fees (GLOBAL STL) and chargebacks (GLOBAL CBK) vs card deposits
queries.sql: SELECT coalesce(-sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE originator = 'GB PY' AND des = 'GLOBAL STL'), 0) / 100.0 AS fees, coalesce(-sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE originator = 'GB PY' AND des = 'GLOBAL CBK'), 0) / 100.0 AS chargebacks, coalesce(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE originator = 'GB PY' AND des = 'GLOBAL DEP'), 0) / 100.0 AS card_deposits, round(100.0 * coalesce(-sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE originator = 'GB PY' AND des = 'GLOBAL STL'), 0) / nullif(sum(cents) FILTER (WHERE originator = 'GB PY' AND des = 'GLOBAL DEP'), 0), 2) AS fee_pct FROM bank

queries.title: Procedures performed and their fees, by CDT code
queries.sql: SELECT procedure_code, count(*) AS procedures, sum(cents) / 100.0 AS fees FROM procedures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY fees DESC

queries.title: Procedures with no ledger invoice for that patient within 14 days (possible unbilled work)
queries.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT pr.date, pr.procedure_code, pr.cents, pl.patient_key FROM procedures pr LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT name_key, patient_key FROM patients) pl USING (name_key)) SELECT p.patient_key AS patient, p.date, p.procedure_code, p.cents / 100.0 AS fee, CASE WHEN p.patient_key IS NULL THEN 'patient not in the patient list' ELSE 'no invoice within 14 days' END AS reason FROM p WHERE p.patient_key IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger l WHERE l.entry = 'invoice' AND l.pt_pseudonym = p.patient_key AND l.date BETWEEN p.date AND p.date + 14) ORDER BY p.date

queries.title: HFD financing: treatment, discount and funded amount by kind
queries.sql: SELECT kind, count(*) AS rows, sum(gross_cents) / 100.0 AS treatment, sum(fee_cents) / 100.0 AS discount, sum(bank_cents) / 100.0 AS funded, round(100.0 * sum(fee_cents) / nullif(sum(gross_cents), 0), 2) AS discount_pct FROM hfd GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

queries.title: Cherry financing: gross, fees and net
queries.sql: SELECT kind, count(*) AS rows, sum(gross_cents) / 100.0 AS gross, sum(fee_cents) / 100.0 AS fees, sum(bank_cents) / 100.0 AS net, round(100.0 * sum(fee_cents) / nullif(sum(gross_cents), 0), 2) AS fee_pct FROM cherry GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

queries.title: Data-quality checks that failed, per file
queries.sql: SELECT file, adapter, check_name, detail FROM file_checks WHERE NOT ok ORDER BY file, check_name

queries.title: MODEL: which leaks lose money, the total, and what the office should do first
queries.question: Which leaks lose money, how much in total, and what should the office do first? Rank by amount.

queries.title: MODEL: which insurance payers owe money, for which remittance dates
queries.question: Which insurance payers owe us money, for which remittance dates and amounts, and what should we ask each payer?

queries.title: MODEL: separate real losses from timing items and posting errors
queries.question: Separate real losses from timing items and from posting errors that move no money. Give the amount of each group.

queries.title: MODEL: which exceptions could explain each other
queries.question: Could any exceptions explain each other (for example an unposted bank credit and a missing EFT of the same payer, or a short batch and a duplicate posting)? Say which, with dates and amounts, and how sure the evidence makes you.

queries.title: MODEL: a checklist for the office manager, one line per exception
queries.question: Write a checklist for the office manager: one line per exception with the action to take in Curve, at the bank or with the payer.

queries.title: MODEL: which process controls would have prevented these leaks
queries.question: Which daily or weekly office controls would have prevented these exceptions? Tie each control to the exceptions it would have caught.

queries.title: MODEL: did the period reconcile, per deposit group
queries.question: For each deposit group (card processor, branch deposit, insurance EFT), say how much Curve posted, how much reached the bank, and how much did not. Use only the group totals in the evidence.

queries.title: MODEL: every amount missing from the bank, with its payment IDs
queries.question: List every exception where money is missing from the bank (negative amount, not watch): code, date, amount and payment IDs or bank rows, largest first.

queries.title: MODEL: money in the bank that Curve never posted
queries.question: Which bank credits are not posted in Curve (positive amounts)? Give the date, amount, payer code and bank row, and say what the office should post.

queries.title: MODEL: insurance EFT follow-up per payer
queries.question: For each insurance payer with a missing EFT or an unposted bank credit, say the remittance date, amount and payment IDs, and what to ask the payer.

queries.title: MODEL: card settlements that do not match the day's card payments
queries.question: Which card settlements do not match the day's card payments? Give the date, the settlement amount, the Curve amount and the difference, and the likely reasons to check.

queries.title: MODEL: branch / ATM deposits: cash and checks not deposited in full
queries.question: Which branch deposits are short of the day's cash and checks? Name any check that was never deposited, with its payment ID and amount.

queries.title: MODEL: posting errors in Curve that move no money
queries.question: Which exceptions are posting errors in Curve that move no money (for example a reference mismatch or a duplicate posting)? Say what to correct in Curve for each.

queries.title: MODEL: timing items to watch, not losses
queries.question: Which items are timing only (watch), how late are they, and when should they become a loss to chase?
